segments.an5.158:1.1: “Pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu sārajjaṃ okkanto [okkamanto (ka.)] hoti.
segments.an5.158:1.3: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu assaddho hoti, dussīlo hoti, appassuto hoti, kusīto hoti, dupañño hoti.
segments.an5.158:1.4: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu sārajjaṃ okkanto hoti.
segments.an5.158:2.1: “Pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu visārado hoti.
segments.an5.158:2.3: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu saddho hoti, sīlavā hoti, bahussuto hoti, āraddhavīriyo hoti, paññavā hoti.
segments.an5.158:2.4: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu visārado hotī”ti.
